summary.text: Elise Stefanik represents New York's 21st District and, according to her office, is in her sixth term.

paragraphs.text: She sits on the House Armed Services, Education and the Workforce, and Intelligence committees.
Earlier she worked on President George W. Bush's Domestic Policy Council staff and in the White House Chief of Staff's office.
She earned a B.A. from Harvard and lives in Schuylerville, New York.
